about.heading: A Little Bit About Me
about.p1: Hi there! My name is Soufyane, a Full Stack Web Developer from Rabat, Morocco.
about.p2_start: I used to study physical and chemical sciences at
about.p2_end: , but I realized early on it wasn't the right direction for me. While finishing the academic year I started learning HTML and CSS on the side.
about.p3_link: Centre Mixte de Formation Professionnelle Hay Nahda (CFHN)
about.p3_end: vocational training school where I graduated as a Fullstack Development Technician, and during this period I built a solid foundation in Frontend and Backend technologies.
about.p4: What I enjoy most about development is the process of building something and watching it work the way it's supposed to. It's genuinely satisfying. I'm always open to learning, and I try to learn from people with more experience, there's a lot I don't know yet and I'm fine with that.
about.p5: Outside of coding I enjoy watching movies, and lately I've been getting into fishing.

contact.heading: Let's Build Something Together!
contact.paragraph: Feel free to get in touch whether you're looking for a developer, have a question, or just want to connect.
